title: OurEconomy
description: Interserver economic system of the KPHV
body:
This is a closed mod for KPHV members.
How to use?
1. Install the mod.
2. Request registration by sending your username and desired password via private message to the registrar in KPHV Discord server.
3. Enter /oe login (username) (password) in chat.
4. Use the mod.

Basic commands:
/oe balance — check your balance.
/oe pay (nickname) — transfer party currency to another party member.
/oe order — create a request to issue armor, server currency, or something else in exchange for party currency.
